description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Adorable Cottage:* Quick Stroll to Beach Access at the End of Somerset Bridge Rd.* 2 Community Pools, Hot Tub, Scenic Walking Bridges & Fishable Lake* Located in Seagrove Beach near some of the best dining on 30A* Walk to Cafe 30A, The Perfect Pig, and Dough Sea Dough Donuts* Minutes from Greenway Station – 30A’s newest shopping and dining destination* Short Drive to Old Florida Fish House and Beachy Bean Coffee* Less Than 2 Miles to Seaside* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef – see Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Guest SupportThis property does not allow parties of adults under the age of 25. No exceptions.Welcome to your perfect 30A beach escape at Four Fish Bungalow 155. This is a charming 2 bedroom, 2.5 bath cottage located in The Bungalows at Seagrove, just 350 yards from beach access. This adorable two-story coastal cottage features a bright, open living space and a fully equipped kitchen, making it ideal for relaxing after a day at the beach. Upstairs you’ll find a king master suite and a guest bedroom with two queen beds, comfortably accommodating up to 6 guests. Spend your days enjoying the sugar-white sand and emerald waters, then return to the peaceful bungalow community to unwind by the pool or stroll along the scenic walking bridges. Whether you're exploring 30A or simply relaxing by the beach, Four Fish Bungalow 155 is the perfect place to create lasting vacation memories.Snowbird InformationWe LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates. Snowbird Season runs November through February and is available on a monthly basis. All monthly rentals include an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us for more information!The Bed Setup2nd Floor-Master Bedroom: King Bed-Guest Bedroom: Two Queen BedsThe Bungalows at Seagrove is a charming planned community of 56 individual cottages, located in Seagrove Beach less than 2 miles east of Seaside along Scenic Highway 30A. This offers beautifully landscaped grounds with:2 swimming poolsHot tubScenic lake with fishingWalking paths and wooden bridgesAbundant parkingGuests are within walking distance of bike, golf cart, and kayak rentals, plus convenient spots for beach essentials. A Tom Thumb convenience store is just a 4-minute walk, and Goatfeathers Seafood Market is nearby for fresh seafood, steamed shrimp, smoked tuna dip, and more.Area AttractionsSeaside is one of the most beloved destinations along 30A, famously featured in The Truman Show starring Jim Carrey. Known for its charming coastal architecture and vibrant town center, Seaside offers a farmer’s market, unique boutiques, incredible dining, and beautiful beach views.Visitors can enjoy endless activities including bike rentals, kayaking, paddleboarding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis—making it a perfect destination for families and beach lovers alike.Greenway Station is Seagrove Beach’s newest hub for shopping, dining, and gathering along 30A. Popular spots include Wild Olives Tapas & Wine Bar, Pecan Jack’s Ice Cream, Coast Hippie, YOLO Board + Bike, Local Cantina Mexican Restaurant, Souper Jenny Coffee Roasters, Canopy Road Café, and more.Snorkelers will love the Sea Turtle Reef, an artificial reef deployed in 2017 located about 783 feet offshore from Grayton Beach State Park access. The reef sits in 12–19 feet of water and has quickly become a thriving habitat for marine life. Visitors are encouraged to use a kayak, paddleboard, or flotation device when visiting the reefs, as Gulf conditions can change quickly. Read less
